concerns.text: Task T005 requires recruiting a separate coder panel (≥ 5 coders) and collecting binary judgments on manipulated images. This external human recruitment step cannot be executed deterministically by an automated agent, making the task unexecutable without manual intervention. The verification unit test only checks the agreement calculation, not the data collection itself.

Task T006 depends on interfacing with a recruitment API to obtain the number of participants indicated by T016. External participant recruitment is non‑deterministic and may fail or vary across runs, preventing fully automated execution. The integration test assumes a pilot session can be run automatically, which is unrealistic without mock participants.

Task T010’s verification is listed as a “Manual reviewer check – no automated test required.” Lack of an automated verification step means the task’s completion cannot be programmatically confirmed, violating the executability requirement for deterministic pipelines.
